items.information:
Välkommen till de första tävlingarna att arrangeras i tvillingformat i Sverige! Denna tävling hör ihop med [Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021), och det är endast tillåtet att anmäla sig och tävla i en av dessa två tävlingar. Mer information om detta finns under fliken [Tvillingtävling](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16201-tvillingtavling-twin-competition). 

Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Detta gäller särskilt fliken [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16170-covid-19), med de smittoskyddsåtgärder som kommer gälla under tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är gratis, mer information finns på Svekubs [hemsida](https://svekub.se/). 

Slutligen vill vi påminna om att COVID-19 situationen är mycket osäker, och att sena förändringar inklusive att tävlingen ställs in med kort varsel tyvärr inte går att utesluta. Håll därför nära koll på denna hemsida samt er email för att få den senaste informationen och kom ihåg att arrangörerna endast kan återbetala anmälningsavgiften, inte personliga reseutgifter.

-----

Welcome to the first ever twin competitions in Sweden! This competition is twinned with [Flen - Lilla Manschetten 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenLillaManschetten2021), and competitors may only register for and compete in one out of these two competitions. More on this can be found under the [Twin competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16201-tvillingtavling-twin-competition) tab.

Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. This includes especially the [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlenStoraManschetten2021#16170-covid-19) tab, with the measures in place to limit the spread of the virus at the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. The membership is free, although a Swedish personal number is needed, more information can be found on the SveKub [website](https://svekub.se/).

Lastly, we would like to remind you that the COVID-19 situation is very uncertain, and that late changes including a cancellation of the competition on short notice can't be ruled out. Therefore, please keep an eye on this website and your email to receive the latest information, and keep in mind that the organizers will only be able to refund the registration fee, not personal travel expenses.

items.information:
This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it!

As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. 

There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition.

If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. Additionally, please note that the rounds are scheduled with more time than usual to account for stationary groups and sanitation time.

**YOU MUST READ THE COVID SAFETY TAB PRIOR TO REGISTERING.**

items.information:
Ceci est la 184ème competition sur le sol Français, autant de compétitions auquelles a participé François Courtès, décédé en 2016. Il a grandi à Montpellier.
Cette compétition sera un hommage en son honneur.

**Hommage :** si vous souhaitez faire un discours ou partager des photos (même si vous n'êtes pas présents à la compétition), contactez [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org).

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule) et du [plan d'accès](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**.

L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est le 3x3 à l'aveugle.

----
This is the 184th competition in France, as many competitions as François Courtès attended, before he died in 2016. He grew up in Montpellier.
This competition is a tribute in his honor.

**Memorial:** if you would like to make a speech or share photos (even if you are not attending the competition), please contact [Clément Cherblanc](mailto:ccherblanc@worldcubeassociation.org).

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule) and [access plan](#13873-comment-y-acceder-how-to-access). Also, **please read the registration requirements carefully**.

The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Blindfolded.

items.information:
Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve.
Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition.
**Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.**

**REPAS** :
Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition.
Samedi soir, pour 10€ : 
* Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser)
* Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau

Dimanche soir pour 15€ : 
* Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J)
* Un dessert, comme le samedi

**LASER GAME** :
Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€.
Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! 

---
You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event.
We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition.
**Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.**

**DINNERS**:
On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue.
Saturday evening for 10€:
* "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us)
* A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake

Sunday evening for 15€:
* A big pizza (to be chosen on the day)
* A dessert, like on Saturday

**LASER GAME**:
On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€.
Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!
